divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: whole-store path searches and text-extraction scans surface the dedicated proceeding matter among a dozen candidates; reads of its filings, status reports and draft filing package (with comparison reads of two or three other candidates) establish it as the latest; the answer leads with it and names the others as older comparisons. T2 briefly ranked a transaction matter as freshest after its scan report, then a date-aware sweep reversed that before any writing. Reviews in all runs pushed for completeness checks and draft-versus-filed wording, which the check stages applied without changing the matter.
